title.narrative: TB Supranational Reference Laboratory Network in Western and Central Africa - Africa - Multicountry TB WC Africa NTP/SRL (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Multicountry TB WC Africa NTP/SRL, Tuberculosis, National Tuberculosis Programme of the Republic of Benin (PNT)This program has the following goals: Mettre en place un réseau de laboratoires nationaux de référence pour la tuberculose afin d'améliorer le diagnostic de la TB-PS et de la TB-PR en Afrique de l'Ouest et du Centre//Establish a network of national TB reference laboratories to improve the diagnosis of SPT and DR-TB in West and Central Africa. The objectives of this program are: Établir un réseau de laboratoires nationaux de référence pour la tuberculose dans la région de l'Afrique de l'Ouest et du Centre//To establish a network of national reference laboratories for tuberculosis in the West and Central African region. Appuyer le réseau des LNR avec un centre d'excellence pour des formations de qualité, une assistance technique et des systèmes de gestion//Support the NRL network with a center of excellence for quality training, technical assistance and management systems. Renforcer les capacités techniques des LNR prioritaires en matière d'enquêtes de surveillance des maladies au niveau national//Strengthen the technical capacity of priority NRLs for national disease surveillance surveys. Renforcer les capacités techniques et administratives du laboratoire supranational de référence pour la tuberculose (SRL) de Cotonou, au Bénin//Strengthen the technical and administrative capacity of the Supranational Reference Laboratory for Tuberculosis (SRL) in Cotonou, Benin

TB-Other1: % of reported TB cases tested for rifampin resistance
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for QMZ-T-PNTP02
TCP-Other1: Percentage of NTRLs with adequate external quality assurance performance for smear microscopy among the total number of NTRLs performing smear microscopy during the period
MDR-TB-other3: Number and percentage of sensibility tests performed by SRL as a direct service to NTRLs
MDR-TB-other1 : Number and percentage of NTRLs showing adequate performance for (phenotypic) susceptibility testing for 2nd line anti-tuberculosis drugs
TCP-Other2: Number and percentage of stars obtained by all NTRLs that participated in the SLIPTA-WHO QMS assessment
MDR-TB-other2: Number and percentage of NTRLs showing adequate performance for (genotypic) susceptibility testing for second-line anti-tuberculosis drugs
